programme.title: The Right Girl
programme.desc: A spoiled rich girl loses her fortune and is forced to take a job in the real world, where the developing relationship with her new boss and his young son opens her eyes to what money can't buy.

programme.title: Expecting a Miracle
programme.desc: Botched directions lead a struggling couple (Teri Polo, Jason Priestley) to a small Mexican town whose residents have a positive effect on the pair's faltering marriage. Cheech Marin and Rebeka Montoya also star. Directed by Steve Gomer.

programme.title: Cupid, Inc.
programme.desc: A talk-show host receives a visit from a mysterious love expert, who promises he'll reveal her true love to her if she first helps other couples find each other. Her matchmaking efforts don't go smoothly, however, and she begins to question her task.

programme.title: Late Bloomer
programme.desc: Botanist Jenny fled her small town and cruel high school couple Shane and Allison to track rare flowers around the globe. Now back, she's shocked to find Shane has become a teacher and even more surprised when he's determined to make it up to her.

programme.title: Groomzilla
programme.desc: A newly engaged woman makes a wish that her fiancé takes the planning of their wedding seriously, and to her surprise and dismay, her wish comes true.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: In 1930s California, a widowed farmer (Sydney Penny) tries to save her property from being seized by the bank with the help of a kindly drifter, who may be much more than he seems. Based on a novel by Lynn Austin.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do?
programme.desc: Author Jessica Bender is forced to work with her former boyfriend and editor Mike Pryce. During this association, the two ex begin to realize that the spark of their love is not yet completely extinguished.

programme.title: Love's Everlasting Courage
programme.desc: Farmer Clark Davis struggles to repay a loan and save his land during a drought. Making matters worse, his wife becomes gravely ill after agreeing to take a job in order to bring in more income.

programme.title: Honeymoon for One
programme.desc: A Los Angeles advertising exec travels to Ireland alone for her honeymoon after breaking things off with her dishonest fiancé. While abroad, she develops a connection with a local estate manager, but a conflict involving the woman's business threatens the budding romance.

programme.title: Heart of the Matter
programme.desc: A professional photographer visits her hometown and becomes reacquainted with a man who once broke her heart.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: A woman returns home to Texas after an eight-year absence to claim the ranch her grandfather left to her in his will. Unfortunately, she has to somehow bridge the generation gap when she finds herself at loggerheads with her father.

programme.title: Mr. Fiction
programme.desc: Emma, a young bookshop owner and hopeless romantic, has to make some tough life choices when the man of her dreams walks into her store.

programme.title: Playing Father
programme.desc: A jazz musician takes a teaching gig at a struggling school and mentors a talented but troubled student. As he helps the teen confront problems at home and school, he also begins to focus on healing his relationship with his own distant son.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: A divorced mom (Lea Thompson) and her kids are forced to bunk with a single dad (Steven Brand) and his two children after a cabin mix-up at a resort in Scotland. Though the adults initially clash, they decide to join forces to compete in a sporting event at the resort, and it's not long before sparks start to fly. Directed by Brian Trenchard-Smith.

programme.title: Love Begins
programme.desc: An adventurer (Wes Brown) pays off a debt by working on a farm owned by a young woman (Julie Mond). As time passes and with nudging from the town's residents, the pair soon begin to fall for one another. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Letter Never Sent
programme.desc: Henry discovers a love letter he wrote in high school to his best friend and attempts to share it to see if she feels the same way, but it ends up in her new boyfriends possession.

programme.title: A Stranger's Heart
programme.desc: Samantha Mathis plays Callie, the recipient of a long-awaited heart transplant whose cynical attitude dissipates as she longs for a connection with her donor's orphaned daughter. Peter Dobson plays Callie's love interest and fellow transplant recipient, but it's Thomas Kopache who steals the show as her perennially grieving widowed father. Andy Wolk directed.

programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream
programme.desc: The sixth installment of the "Love Comes Softly" series follows the now-grown Belinda Tyler (Scout Taylor-Compton) as she struggles to choose between her career aspirations as a doctor and her feelings for a New York lawyer who wants a traditional wife. Clark: Dale Midkiff. Missie: Erin Cottrell.

programme.title: Can't Buy My Love
programme.desc: Lilly, an EMT and aspiring medical student falls for Jeff, a rich, aimless guy.

programme.title: Secret Millionaire
programme.desc: A rich young man hides his identity when he discovers that he is taken by the passion of a woman who is protesting the dealings of his father's company. However, their relationship blossoms and is later on threatened.

programme.title: Fixing Pete
programme.desc: A fashion columnist (Brooke Burns) receives an assignment to make over a sloppy sportswriter (Dylan Bruno). As the pair spend time together, they learn from each other and sparks begin to fly. But romantic complications threaten to keep them apart. Directed by Michael Grossman.

programme.title: Bad Date Chronicles
programme.desc: Leigh runs the popular website 'Bad Date Chronicles' where daters can go to anonymously post horrible date experiences. When rival blogger Conner becomes the subject of one of her posts, they agree to date each other in order to prove which one is actually a bad dater.

programme.title: Brimming With Love
programme.desc: A skeptical journalist writing a column on a matchmaking coffee shop owner agrees to be matched, but she proves to be a challenge. The reason may be that she is perfect for the matchmaker.

programme.title: The Shell Seekers
programme.desc: Angela Lansbury is a widow searching for a meaning to her life in this teleplay adapted from Rosamunde Pilcher's novel. Olivia: Patricia Hodge. Nancy: Anna Carteret. Noel: Christopher Bowen. Antonia: Sophie Ward. Richard: Sam Wanamaker. Danus: Mark Lewis Jones. Cosmo: Denis Quilley. Dolly: Irene Worth. Roy: Michael Gough. George: John Rowe. Filmed in England and Spain.

programme.title: Easy Heart
programme.desc: A music teacher hires a struggling country singer to perform at her town's annual festival, but the musician's difficult behavior causes problems. The pair soon find common ground in music, however, and inspire each other to embark on new paths.

programme.desc: A spoiled rich girl loses her fortune and is forced to take a job in the real world, where the developing relationship with her new boss and his young son opens her eyes to what money can't buy.

programme.title: Mixed Baggage
programme.desc: When Evie Jones rushes off a flight to make her connection, she has no idea that in her haste, she has grabbed the wrong duffel bag.

programme.title: Shadow on the Mesa

programme.title: Cupid, Inc.
programme.desc: A talk-show host receives a visit from a mysterious love expert, who promises he'll reveal her true love to her if she first helps other couples find each other. Her matchmaking efforts don't go smoothly, however, and she begins to question her task.
